input.normalization: one official DA3 ImageNet normalization of pinned raw RGB pixels

numerical_gate.pass_means: same DA3 computation within fixed tolerance, not SLAM quality

export_adapters: fixed official integer y/x PositionGetter grid
fixed official FP32 DPT positional embeddings, same addition and weights
graph_scope: Complete learned depth, confidence and raw-pose paths. Original unused auxiliary ray path can be pruned. Official pose codec remains CPU.

timing.caveat: One call per pair; not sustained throughput, acquisition latency, or a controlled CPU speedup comparison

NPU_status: Default RKNN 2.3.2 compiler fails gather_to_conv with IndexError. Disabling only that rule then fails compiler constant folding on an earlier generated Gather (idx 48 exceeds channel range [-32,31]). Neither failed attempt emits RKNN or runs board NPU. Additionally disabling the producing fuse_channel_shuffle_split_concat_to_gather rule successfully builds the unchanged graph; subsequent board mixed CPU/NPU runtime and numerical differences are recorded separately in da3_rknn_v24.json.
artifacts_published: Source helpers, tests and JSON evidence only; no weights, ONNX, RKNN, saved image/prediction arrays, or vendor binaries.
